theme: Light theme, architectural and spacious, with a deep 'forest green' dark sidebar for a premium, grounded real estate aesthetic.

body.style: Highly legible for data density, modern geometric

spacing_and_layout.dashboard_grid: Bento style, dense but organized. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6.
spacing_and_layout.padding: Generous on containers (p-6 to p-8), tighter on inner cards (p-4 to p-5)
spacing_and_layout.borders: Exposed grids for data-heavy sections. 1px solid borders for structure.
spacing_and_layout.radius: Minimal rounded edges. rounded-sm (2px) to rounded-md (6px) max. Avoid large bubbly corners.
spacing_and_layout.sidebar: Fixed width 260px, dark theme (#102A20) to anchor the UI. Solid background, no transparency.

components.kanban: Subtle column backgrounds (#F1EFEA), white task cards with 1px border. Strict column borders.
components.inventory_grid: Matrix layout mimicking a building's structure. Tight squares for units. Green=Available, Red=Booked, Grey=Held.
components.cards: Flat, 1px border (#E6E4DD), no shadow by default. Hover adds shadow-sm and slightly darkens border.
components.buttons: Sharp corners or rounded-sm. Primary button: bg-[#102A20] text-white hover:bg-[#1A362D]. Secondary: border border-[#102A20] text-[#102A20].
components.inputs: Shadcn defaults modified. border-[#E6E4DD] bg-transparent focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#102A20].
components.badges: For lead sources. Flat rectangular badges, no pill shape unless strictly needed.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Buttons and links must explicitly change color/opacity.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use specific transition classes (e.g., transition-colors duration-200), NEVER transition-all.
motion_and_interactions.loading: Skeleton loaders matching the data grid shapes.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Ambient drop shadows only on hovering cards or dropdown menus.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle grain on the dark sidebar or large hero areas.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Not recommended for data CRM. Stick to solid, opaque backgrounds for maximum data clarity.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure 4.5:1 ratio. Dark green text on white/bone backgrounds.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.

media.image_usage: Projects use architectural exteriors. Leads/Team use executive portraits. Units use luxury interiors.

instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT use 'Inter', 'Roboto', or generic fonts. Import 'Cabinet Grotesk' for Headings and 'Manrope' for body.
Avoid purple/violet completely. The app must feel architectural, professional, and confident.
Implement the Layout with a fixed Sidebar (Dark green) and a main content area (Warm Bone/Off-white).
Use Shadcn UI components but strip away the generic rounded 'Vercel' look; use tight corner radiuses (rounded-sm) and flat colors.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, inputs, tabs, and clickable elements.
For the Kanban and Inventory Grid, prioritize density and clear strict borders.
Always ensure a proper visual hierarchy in data tables: uppercase headers, subtle borders, highlight the primary column.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use Phosphor or Lucide icons.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
